Racket._comment: The player's racket and where it sits in the hand (GDD 10). Cosmetic only: shots are the shot model's. Metres and degrees. Read by UPadelPlayerAnimComponent; the maths is in Source/Padel/Public/Animation/Model/RacketGrip.h and the mesh is built by Tools/AssetPipeline (config/racket.json). The grip is solved from the hand's joint positions in the reference pose, so it fits the placeholder skeleton and the MetaHumans alike. See docs/decisions/0008-racket.md.
